text:
elaine_cs: Quick heads up — AcmeCorp renewal (50 seats) cleared internally. Procurement says we need: PO#, vendor code, and DocuSign executed by their Finance lead. They also want a security addendum signed by Security. They asked if they can pay by credit card vs wire. They want this closed by Fri EOD. Who can drive signatures + payment path? cc @mike_acct @jordan_legal

mike_acct: I can own the PO/vendor code side. Reaching out to Melissa in procurement now — will confirm the required PO fields and GL code. ETA ~24h.

jordan_legal: From legal side, prefer to keep our standard T&Cs. For the security addendum — need to confirm whether they accept our SOC2 attestation or expect a custom addendum. @tom_success can you ask the buyer for the addendum draft?

tom_success: On it. Just spoke to buyer — their portal enforces a 3-approver flow (procurement, legal, finance). They *can* do credit card but flag it costs them a ~2% processing fee. They prefer vendor code + PO if possible.

sophia_fin: If they pay by CC we still need a PO with a "credit card final" note on it for our records. For net30/PO path, we'll need finance approval for invoice splitting if they're billing the EU subsidiary. CC definitely speeds onboarding. :thinking_face: 

elaine_cs: Decision checkpoint: CC vs PO? If CC -> DocuSign only by their finance lead. If PO/net30 -> invoice split & billing entity confirmation required. @jordan_legal any redlines on pricing/term?

jordan_legal: Pricing is fine. Term ask: they want to shorten from 12 -> 9 months (pro rata). Ops note: seat true-up and renewal window changes. Recommend we allow 9mo pro rata but keep auto-renew term intact. Thoughts?

mike_acct: 9 months OK from billing — I'll update SOW dates and add pro rata clause. Preparing an amended SOW + procurement instructions.

tom_success: Scheduling 30-min signoff call tomorrow 10:00am PT to lock this. Can @elaine_cs @mike_acct @jordan_legal @sophia_fin join?

sophia_fin: 10am PT works for me — I'll bring our billing lead for quick vendor-code confirmation.

esign-bot: esign-bot: Draft envelope created: AcmeCorp_Renewal_1769994321. Waiting for final SOW attachment. Doc link: https://docusign.example/abc123

mike_acct: Procurement sample email I'm sending to Melissa (copying whoever joins):

```
Subject: PO request for Redwood Inference - AcmeCorp
Body:
Hi Melissa,

AcmeCorp needs a PO to process the renewal. Please provide PO number with vendor code VC-9987 and GL code 4510. Attached: amended SOW and billing instructions. Customer requests net30 under EU entity if they choose PO path.
Thanks,
Mike
```

elaine_cs: Attaching SOW v2: https://files.example/acme/sow-v2.pdf — updated dates and pro rata clause. Please review *before* the 10am call.

jordan_legal: Quick pass done. One minor change: replace "liquidated damages" language in section 6 with "service credits" — I'll push that small redline into the SOW and re-upload before the call.

mike_acct: Procurement confirmed vendor code VC-9987 for US billing entity. They also gave a portal note: if customer selects EU billing entity, use VC-RE-EU-01. @sophia_fin can you confirm?

sophia_fin: Confirmed. VC-9987 = Redwood Inc (US). VC-RE-EU-01 = Redwood EU (VAT ID on file). Customer must pick the correct billing entity in the portal or invoice will route incorrectly.

elaine_cs: Plan: 1) Send calendar invite for 10am PT signoff. 2) If CC route chosen, we'll route DocuSign ASAP and they can pay same day. 3) If PO route chosen, expect 48-72h procurement processing after PO submission. Aim to have signature complete by Friday. :party_parrot:

tom_success: Invite sent, calendar + join link. If anything blocks between now and the call, drop it in this thread and I'll escalate.

(edited) tom_success: Note — buyer also requested a short onboarding checklist to start post-signature. I'll draft a 1-page enablement plan and post here after call.
